lead_story.title: R-Zero touts adoption of building optimization system, forthcoming ‘intelligence layer’
lead_story.summary: The company known for occupancy-based building intelligence says its AI-supported platform is helping to improve systems in a broader range of property types.

top_stories.title: How Richmond, Va., schools are tackling a $680M facilities funding shortfall
top_stories.summary: Voters approved a 1% sales tax to help with funding. In an assessment, each school’s needs are weighed against what replacement would cost.

top_stories.title: Costco opens largest gas station to date
top_stories.summary: The retailer’s new site at its warehouse in Issaquah, Washington, has 50 fueling positions and required extensive renovation of an existing facility.

top_stories.title: Consumer devices connected to work-related networks pose risk: Claroty
top_stories.summary: The cybersecurity firm found more than 65,000 gaming consoles, entertainment devices and cars connected to mission-critical networks.

top_stories.title: When elevator repairs become a facilities capital planning problem
top_stories.summary: Several service calls do not establish that an elevator has reached the end of its useful service. Calls might concern unrelated defects, an unresolved building condition or the same fault reported by several occupants.

top_stories.title: Elevated demand for gas turbines could persist through 2035: Siemens Energy
top_stories.summary: The U.S. midterms are not likely to slow turbine orders by data centers, company executives said, noting that turbine demand is also coming from diverse industries with long-term growth trajectories.

lead_story.title: First Hospitality names Sam Schwartz CEO
lead_story.summary: After serving as chairman of the board since 2025, Schwartz succeeds David Duncan to lead the company’s “next chapter of growth.”

top_stories.title: US hotel investment reached $22.2B in Q3 fueled by larger deals, urban recovery: JLL
top_stories.summary: Contributing to an uptick in investment activity are hotel fundamentals that “have dramatically exceeded expectations” so far this year, said Dan Peek, Americas president of JLL’s Hotels & Hospitality Group.

top_stories.title: How Hyatt’s revamped loyalty rewards cater to shifting traveler demand
top_stories.summary: By expanding its World of Hyatt Milestone Rewards chart, Hyatt builds on a strategy to make loyalty “more relevant across the full travel journey,” SVP Laurie Blair shares.

top_stories.title: Marriott faces technical issues amid flurry of US outages, disruptions
top_stories.summary: A company spokesperson said tech complications impacted sign-in capabilities on its website and the Marriott Bonvoy app earlier this week, though cybersecurity was a non-factor.

top_stories.title: Apartment Collection by Hilton signs first international properties
top_stories.summary: The apartment-style accommodations brand enters its next phase of growth with upcoming properties in the Middle East and Caribbean. The expansion also marks its first development partner beyond Placemakr.

top_stories.title: Choice Hotels launches experiential loyalty rewards platform
top_stories.summary: Access by Choice Privileges allows members to earn and redeem points on sporting events, concerts, tours and more as hotels tap into experiences to cater to shifting travel preferences.

lead_story.title: Subtext adds student properties in Texas and Nevada
lead_story.summary: After delivering 3,105 beds this year, the St. Louis-based firm added properties in Austin and Reno near universities with “strong enrollment trajectories,” according to executive Mike Hung.

top_stories.title: Progress Residential, owner Pretium Partners settle FTC rental fee suit for $50M
top_stories.summary: The enforcement action is the agency’s largest-ever against a landlord, and “regulators are going to be going after these big firms because the target is on their back,” one expert said.

top_stories.title: HUD finalizes rule targeting mixed-immigration-status households receiving aid
top_stories.summary: The rule could displace tens of thousands of people, housing organizations say. A lawsuit claims the change is illegal and unconstitutional.

top_stories.title: Multifamily starts rose in October amid high borrowing, materials costs
top_stories.summary: Although HUD and the U.S. Census Bureau data shows a monthly and yearly increase in apartment construction, “the broad landscape remains tepid,” according to an economist.

top_stories.title: How apartment developers can successfully install connected services
top_stories.summary: Multifamily firms need to look beyond “technology glitter” and keep residents and staff front and center when putting Wi-Fi, access controls and other features into buildings, Cortland’s Duncan Cannon said at OPTECH.

top_stories.title: Perennial Housing launches as affordable owner, operator
top_stories.summary: CEO Gregory Jones intends to grow its inaugural 31-property, 4,000-unit portfolio in the Southeast and Midwest with more Section 8 and other affordable housing properties.

lead_story.title: New York City plans to charge fee as waste containerization rollout expands
lead_story.summary: The city’s Department of Sanitation is proposing to charge building owners up to $55 per bin in order to cover installation and maintenance costs. It’s also expanding use of the bins to more neighborhoods.

top_stories.title: Local government AI readiness corresponds to community size, survey finds
top_stories.summary: “We can barely keep our heads above water with reactive projects, let alone begin to think big about visionary ideas,” a civil service leader in a small town in Massachusetts said in the CivicPulse and CivicPlus survey.

top_stories.title: Air taxi developers begin passenger flights under strict FAA guidance
top_stories.summary: Archer Aviation, Beta Technologies and Joby Aviation are moving closer to federal certification and commercial operations as they conduct piloted flights in cities and states across the country.

top_stories.title: HUD finalizes rule targeting mixed-immigration-status households receiving aid
top_stories.summary: The rule could displace tens of thousands of people, housing organizations say. A lawsuit claims the change is illegal and unconstitutional.

top_stories.title: Data centers poised to be more community friendly, a Johnson Controls executive says
top_stories.summary: Innovation in compressors, fans, waterless systems, noise attenuation and heat reuse can address many of the concerns people have, solutions architecture chief Mihir Nandkeolyar says.

top_stories.title: How cities are making global sporting events pay off
top_stories.summary: Hosting a World Cup or Super Bowl is just the beginning. Kansas City, Missouri, and Santa Clara, California, used those events to build civic identity and community.

lead_story.title: Google signs 50-MW superhot geothermal PPA with Quaise Energy
lead_story.summary: The agreement will support Google's Oregon data center operations beginning as early as 2030, advancing development of a technology designed to access geothermal resources deeper underground.

top_stories.title: Grid operators need data center ride-through rules that protect reliability
top_stories.summary: Large load ride-through concerns can be addressed, but the power sector must adopt rules that protect grid reliability while providing certainty to the data center industry, writes ON.energy CEO Alan Cooper.

top_stories.title: PJM urged to delay base capacity auction until data centers cut from forecast
top_stories.summary: State ratepayer advocates and the grid operator’s market monitor say holding the auction in December as planned threatens grid reliability and could hit consumers with billions in unnecessary costs.

top_stories.title: Fuel constraints could challenge grid this winter, despite resource improvements: NERC
top_stories.summary: Areas of the Midwest, Southeast and New England must be wary of transmission and pipeline constraints that could cause resource shortfalls during periods of extreme weather, the reliability watchdog said.

top_stories.title: New York state is short electric resources beginning 2033: ISO
top_stories.summary: New York will face an approximately 225 MW statewide resource deficiency beginning 2033, with the need for power resources growing to 1,850 MW by 2036, the state’s grid operator said Wednesday.

top_stories.title: The grid will fall short of AI’s power needs. These 6 resources can close the gap.
top_stories.summary: No single option is fast, firm and large enough on its own, writes Simon Irish, CEO of Terrestrial Energy. Some investments — flexibility, uprates and transmission — remain valuable across demand scenarios, he says.

lead_story.title: Amazon sets 2030 goal to cut carbon intensity of its electricity consumption
lead_story.summary: The tech and e-commerce giant aims to reduce the carbon emissions generated for every unit of electricity it consumes across its operations by 65%, compared to a 2019 baseline.

top_stories.title: Data center cancellations in Q3 double: Relae
top_stories.summary: Sixteen data center projects were stopped in Q3, up from seven in the third quarter of 2025. Climate solutions company Relae, formerly known as Carbon Direct, tracked 70 cancellations since 2024.

top_stories.title: Intel shareholders sue CEO, CFO after stock rout
top_stories.summary: CEO Lip-Bu Tan and CFO David Zinsner failed to properly disclose the full impact of waning PC demand on company revenue and profitability for the PC maker, shareholders claim.

top_stories.title: Anthropic labeled ‘high risk’ as investors’ concerns rise pre-IPO
top_stories.summary: As the company behind artificial intelligence platform Claude heads towards its initial public offering, investors are flagging ESG risks in the company’s business model and financials.

top_stories.title: Chief AI officers lack control over enterprise AI investment decisions
top_stories.summary: AI leaders have broad insight into the tech’s value but need to deliver evidence to shape C-suite decisions, an IBM Institute for Business Value report found.

top_stories.title: Levi’s appoints new CSO to help decarbonize operations, supply chain
top_stories.summary: The denim giant has tapped industry vet Jeannie Renné-Malone to oversee its global sustainability strategy in her new dual role as chief sustainability officer and vice president, effective Dec.1.

lead_story.title: Is RCRA’s waste and recycling system ready for a manufacturing boom?
lead_story.summary: RCRA’s rollout was turbulent for manufacturers and environmental services providers. Hazardous waste and scrap companies are prepping for new demand, and awaiting details about EPA reform plans.

top_stories.title: Collection worker injuries down, but landfill injuries up in 2025
top_stories.summary: MRF workers experienced the highest illness rate of waste industry groups, but experienced fewer injuries compared to the previous year, according to annual data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics.

top_stories.title: RCRA forced thousands of landfills to close. What happened to them?
top_stories.summary: The federal law raised landfill standards but left it up to states to manage thousands of dumps closed without consistent standards. Now, many sites are left unmonitored despite public health risks.

top_stories.title: Lessons from Washington’s PCR law, 3 years into enforcement
top_stories.summary: The policy is successfully spurring the use of recycled plastic, even as thresholds and categories increase, said APR’s Kate Bailey. But some companies, such as Ocean Spray, continue to use no PCR and face penalties.

top_stories.title: Agri-Cycle acquires 3 organics haulers, now servicing 30 states
top_stories.summary: The private equity-backed organics hauler announced its first deals since entering the Closed Loop portfolio last year. They included companies based in Arkansas, Massachusetts and Rhode Island.

top_stories.title: Nth Cycle prepares to go public as US critical minerals policy shifts
top_stories.summary: CEO Megan O'Connor said the company's plans for both a black mass refining facility and licensing agreements for its refining tech are part of a larger plan to develop critical minerals infrastructure in the U.S.

lead_story.title: Senate appropriations committee proposes $15B in additional Pell Grant funding
lead_story.summary: The Republican-led bill for fiscal 2027 would also keep funding flat for the U.S. Department of Education’s Office for Civil Rights.

top_stories.title: M State’s Detroit Lakes campus to close amid systemwide budget woes
top_stories.summary: System leaders voted to shutter the location, which enrolls just over 100 students, as soon as summer 2028.

top_stories.title: Stopped-out student population reaches 37.8M, data finds
top_stories.summary: About 1.9 million people in this group left higher education recently, according to the National Student Clearinghouse Research Center.

top_stories.title: Court blocks DHS policy limiting international student training opportunities
top_stories.summary: The higher education groups suing to strike down new limits on the Curricular Practical Training program are likely to succeed, a federal judge ruled.

top_stories.title: PASSHE moves to close Commonwealth University’s Mansfield campus
top_stories.summary: The public college system’s leader said the campus faces persistent deficits and long-running enrollment declines.

top_stories.title: ABA accreditation arm moves to nix full-time faculty standard for first-year classes
top_stories.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice recently threatened an antitrust probe over the requirement, arguing that it drives up legal education costs.

lead_story.title: Senate committee’s FY27 plan gives Education Department 19% boost
lead_story.summary: Funding would increase for special education and stay level for Title I, according to a Senate Appropriations Committee proposal.

top_stories.title: Education Department faces management challenges from recent changes, watchdog says
top_stories.summary: Interagency agreements and a handful of executive orders were cited in an annual report as key factors in five issues facing the agency in 2027.

top_stories.title: Here are the states with ESEA waivers from the Trump administration
top_stories.summary: We're tracking the Returning Education to the States waivers granted by the U.S. Department of Education since January 2026.

top_stories.title: Fewer than half of students are kindergarten-ready, GAO says
top_stories.summary: A five-state analysis shows girls, as well as Asian and White children, were more prepared. Boys, Black students and those with disabilities were less so.

top_stories.title: 29 states will require finance course in high school by 2031, report predicts
top_stories.summary: Ten states received an “A” for requiring standalone personal finance courses in the National Endowment for Financial Education’s latest report.

top_stories.title: How can districts keep CTE programs relevant as tech evolves?
top_stories.summary: The rapid pace of change can make it difficult for even employers to have clear answers for workplace readiness, an industry expert says.

lead_story.title: Coca-Cola pivots from divisive AI-generated ads for holiday campaign
lead_story.summary: After facing backlash for holiday ads that used generative AI, “Enjoy Joy” spots show family and friends partaking in seasonal activities.

top_stories.title: Walmart mulls role advertising will play in an agentic shopping world
top_stories.summary: Momentum for the retailer’s ad business remains strong, but executives acknowledged that AI agents are producing notably different consumer behaviors.

top_stories.title: Sociable: Instagram adds Amazon affiliate links
top_stories.summary: The partnership enables creators to add up to 30 shoppable products per Reel.

top_stories.title: Bumble cozies up to Alix Earle in attempt to convert Gen Zers
top_stories.summary: The social-forward campaign comes just weeks after the app’s parent company announced it is to be acquired for $1.3 billion following revenue and user declines.

top_stories.title: How SharkNinja is doubling down on its creator strategy
top_stories.summary: Two new programs — one for employees and one for content creators — will help the brand continue to build out its social media presence.

top_stories.title: How Disney helps brands interact and transact with holiday audiences
top_stories.summary: Partnerships with Chevrolet, Bath & Body Works and Ally around last night's CMA Awards showcase the media giant's evolving advertising strategy.

lead_story.title: Meta launches shopping platform Achados in Brazil
lead_story.summary: The marketplace tool combines product listings from across the company’s apps into a unified display.

top_stories.title: Threads tests new Q&A option in live chats
top_stories.summary: The platform is experimenting with a format that would allow chat hosts to solicit questions, and have chat participants vote on what to ask.

top_stories.title: Reddit publishes guide to Super Bowl engagement trends
top_stories.summary: The platform said that brands looking to engage with subreddit communities should begin well ahead of the 2027 game in order to map out effective approaches.

top_stories.title: LinkedIn study explores B2B buying decisions
top_stories.summary: The research highlights the importance of relational factors, such as testimonials and peer validation, when it comes to influencing client purchases.

top_stories.title: Instagram adds Stories editing
top_stories.summary: The platform rolled out various Stories feature updates, including the much-request option to make changes to Stories after posting.

top_stories.title: TikTok releases 2026 Music Impact Report
top_stories.summary: The analysis found that 94% of songs on the Billboard Global 200 in 2025 had a viral moment on TikTok before climbing the chart.

lead_story.title: How Hyatt’s revamped loyalty rewards cater to shifting traveler demand
lead_story.summary: By expanding its World of Hyatt Milestone Rewards chart, Hyatt builds on a strategy to make loyalty “more relevant across the full travel journey,” SVP Laurie Blair shares.

top_stories.title: Walmart is building an omnichannel environment around agentic AI
top_stories.summary: “We're creating an environment where agents can help a customer discover new items and decide what to buy,” CEO John Furner said.

top_stories.title: Most companies use AI in CX silos. The next step is connecting them.
top_stories.summary: Customers should have a unified experience of brands they buy from. Delivering that requires considerable integration.

top_stories.title: With tariff refunds, Lowe’s wants to strengthen value proposition, CX
top_stories.summary: “We thought first about how we are going to share these refunds with the customer,” CEO Marvin Ellison said on an earnings call.

top_stories.title: Target’s CX investments ready it for a strong holiday season
top_stories.summary: The retailer’s major CX transformations for the year are behind it, and it will focus on delivering an exceptional holiday shopping experience, executives said.

top_stories.title: Air Canada sold a portion of its loyalty program. Will others follow?
top_stories.summary: After Air Canada sold one-quarter of its loyalty program, investors and analysts asked whether other brands ought to replicate such a plan.
